cohort: Singletons with recorded BMI who delivered at a Level IV center over two consecutive years, with gestational age >= 14 weeks.
finding: Parturients with a BMI >= 30 had a higher risk of hemorrhage-related morbidity compared to those with BMI < 30.
mod_finding: Increased risk for composite maternal hemorrhagic outcome (CMHO) was found for BMI >= 40 in vaginal deliveries and for BMI of 30 to 39.9 in cesarean deliveries.
